tests.skip_note: Unchanged Torch-dependent tests were passed separately in the training runtime; new guard tests are CPU/inference-runtime tests.

actual_existing_condition.scope: One existing actual trained condition/proof only, no new model or two-policy treatment result.
actual_existing_condition.self_pair_refused: Identical critic weights are not a policy contrast

checks: Two distinct full trained critic policies; unchanged actor, noncritic configuration, source/code/model/runtime/cap metadata
Current immutable adapters and model/source artifacts validated; each reversible proof recomputed and bound to its training-validation prompt
Complete input order, no repairs, intended per-role C adapter handles, actual prompt/token allowances matched
Original generated plans, source execution, both numerical scores, binary verdicts and delivery flags replayed
No-context failures remain in the denominator; explicit trained condition labels; duplicate/untrained labels refused
limits: Actual positive integration audit covers the existing one trained critic only. Successful two-distinct-policy pairing is unit-fixture tested; a real pair cannot be evaluated until the extended critic is trained, converted, proved and run. Numerical/source replay is not independent semantic truth or publication confirmation.
